Patient: I’m 45 years old, and the main change I’ve noticed is the rapid growth of the mass in my right breast over the past three weeks. I haven’t had any pain, and I haven’t noticed any changes to the skin or my nipple.
Have you noticed any discharge from your nipple, or any lumps in your armpit on that side?

Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any nipple discharge, and I also haven’t felt any lumps in my armpit on that side. I’ve mainly just noticed the rapidly enlarging mass in my right breast over the past three weeks.

Patient: I haven’t had any recent trauma or injury to my right breast. I don’t have any personal history of breast cancer, and there’s no family history of breast cancer that I’m aware of.
